name: Barharia
registryBasis: Government of Bihar district administration identifies Barharia as a block/circle under Siwan Sadar, while the official Bihar BhuNaksha viewer’s anonymous hierarchy includes Siwan/Siwan Sadar/Barharia circle and mauza. This confirms local map inventory presence, but not exact WUP-point geometry.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Static viewer HTML and JavaScript inspected before requests. Only state selector transition and administrative level OP=2 selectors were used. WMS capabilities request returned 500. WMS rendering and plot selection/detail routes were not invoked.
scopeLimits: Barharia local map area is present in the public BhuNaksha selectors. The client exposes image layers and separate plot-detail routes; no safe complete vector geometry+ID response was verified, and no parcel-specific calls were made.
remainingUncertainty: No complete georeferenced polygon or native feature ID was verified at the WUP point; public map viewers may provide display-only or identity-dependent workflows not tested.

Static client code shows the map rendered via WMS and plot click/search calls return plot IDs/details through separate routes.
